topics.title: NR2B NAM – MDD Adjunctive Ph2 TLR Local Communication Plan

background.text: Ph2 MDD Adjunctive TLR: China early asset team members and RA representative will be informed via global meeting invitation. Per global guidance, high-level information shared only to local EoP2 submission team and local MKT/MA core team for ICP. Further distribution at townhall on July 10th together with Ph2 MDD Monotherapy TLR. External communications only after both trials have read out.
background.quote:
Ph2 MDD Adjunctive TLR:
China early asset team members and RA representative will be informed with global meeting invitation.
Per global guidance, high level information can be shared only to local EoP2 submission team and local MKT/MA core team for ICP.
Further distribution will be made at the townhall on July 10th together with Ph2 MDD Monotherapy TLR.
External communications only after both trials have read out.
